answer: Fielding 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 live storage vaults: every identity is dealt one unique shard of the network's archive — a timber beam in a shared warehouse — and must return a random slice of it on demand, a pulse check every epoch. An honest agent stores one shard on disk it already owns, nearly free. A farmer must store 1,000 distinct shards and answer 1,000 simultaneous retrieval pulses; one shared copy fails the timing test, and a missed pulse sends a ripple through the ledger, freezing that fake's payouts until re-audit.
